## Workload

During the review period, grader Kofi Asante completed 630 reads over 292 hours. This represents an average throughput of 2.2 reads per hour. The workload record provides the basis for assessing the volume of work completed and the time required to complete it.

## Quality

A sample of 58 reads was checked as part of the quality review. The level of agreement was 75.9 per cent. These results were considered by reviewer Priya Anand, who reviewed the workload and quality information for the period.
